params.caption:
🎮 Ubisoft just denied forcing developers to use generative AI!

After reports that teams felt "cornered" into using AI and had to justify skipping it on pitches, Ubisoft pushed back with an official statement.

📌 Ubisoft: "We encourage our teams to explore where AI can be useful. This doesn't mean projects are required to use generative AI. Teams need to determine whether, and how, these technologies make sense."

📌 The original report (via Vertical Slice) said sources felt management saw AI use as "unavoidable," with pressure reportedly from CEO Yves Guillemot.

📌 Context: Ubisoft recently launched a subsidiary for "AI for gameplay innovation," amid ongoing layoffs this year.

🕒 Published: Nov 26, 2026, 9:42 PM (GMT+3)

📰 Sources: Video Games Chronicle, Vertical Slice

👥 @Ubisoft · @VGC247
